revisions.text: What passes for you are now is a pale imitation of the man you were. To mock someone in your state of frailty is beneath me.
Whatever it is you are now is a pale imitation of the man you were. To muck someone in your state of frailty is beneath me.
Kelvin, whatever it is you are now is a petty imitation of the man you were. To mock someone in your state of frailty is beneath me.
